task_title: Add Phaser animation layer and player walk cycle

plan_review.notes: Separate-model rubber-duck plan review (gpt-5.4) of the shared animation schema, spritesheet routing, animation registration, and PhaserBridge wiring. 2 must-fix blocking concerns: (1) idle-frame semantics undefined after anims.stop() risking a frozen mid-stride pose -> fixed via explicit setFrame(0) snap-back plus test assertion; (2) sheet layout semantics under-specified -> fixed via explicit JSDoc contract (single-row, left-to-right, frame 0..N-1, frame 0 = idle). 5 non-blocking suggestions (velocity-threshold jitter, stale-config on re-registration, shared flip helper, dedicated player switch case, frame-count tiebreaker) noted as acceptable for this slice and left as follow-up opportunities, not required for this PR.

rounds.notes: High-severity finding: player flip logic collapsed 'moving left' and 'stationary'/'moving vertically' into the same mirrored case (movingRight = vx > epsilon), causing the player to snap to a mirrored idle pose every time they stopped or walked straight up/down. Fixed by only re-deriving facing when |vx| exceeds the flip epsilon, otherwise preserving the sprite's current flipX. Added 3 new test assertions (moving-right no-mirror, vertical/stationary facing-preservation, left-then-right re-mirror) to tests/unit/player-walk-animation.test.ts.

Fresh full review of the current diff state (schema, spritesheet routing, animation registration, PhaserBridge wiring, flip fix, idle-frame-0 snap). Confirmed the flip fix's guard and its 3 new test assertions are all correct and load-bearing. All categories (correctness, data flow/lifecycle, API/contracts, security, runtime wiring, regression coverage) reported clean. No further concerns.
